description: The historical power-line database team publishes georeferenced interpretations of Keyhole satellite imagery used to reconstruct an electrical network in the Moscow region. The Figshare repository supplies a GeoPackage of identified pylons and some line segments, freely under CC BY 4.0. It includes the backbone network at 220 kV and above as well as 35 and 110 kV objects that were not carried into the main analysis. These spatial observations can support historical network reconstruction and checks of infrastructure-expansion scenarios. They are interpreted source material, not a complete, validated operating network; missing objects and image interpretation introduce uncertainty. The deposit was published in 2021. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
